resources.string: Delete “%1$s” from the music storage folder? This also removes it from the playback queue, playlists, and Liked songs. This action cannot be undone in the app.
The audio file could not be deleted. Check that it is still in the selected music storage folder and that the app has read and write access to that folder.
Only songs in the selected music storage folder can be edited. Choose a music storage folder, then import or refresh songs.
Enter a number greater than 0. Decimals are accepted; leave blank if unset.
Song details are stored only in the app. Audio files and file names are unchanged. Songs with the same title are managed separately.
